body.x: RF has presented AI-driven robot window cleaner in CES 2019, the largest technology show in the world held in Las Vegas, USA from January 8 (Tue) to 11 (Fri).
The demand for a robot window cleaner in the market is steadily growing because of lifestyle changes and an aging society which have increased the tendency to use glass as an eco-friendly material.

For safety and convenience, RF has been producing and selling robot window cleaner. Last 2017, RF was awarded for Innovation of the Year. The main exportation of RF is in Japan. Through this exhibition, it will expand its market throughout North America and Europe.

Above all, AI-driven robot window cleaner is easy and safe to use because of the permanent magnet which enables the robot to stick on both sides of the glass. As the start button is pressed, it runs autonomously perceiving the location and returns to the designated position when it finishes cleaning.
On top of that, even if the power goes off, the robot window cleaner is attached safely onto the glass due to the permanent magnet, and it cleans the corner end of the window with its microfiber pad.
